question.problem: Find the area of the rectangle $ABCD$ if its perimeter is $40$ and ${BC} = 12.$
question.worked_solution:
We can find the length of ${AB}$ by using the formula for the perimeter, as follows:  

$$
\begin{aligned}p & =AB+BC+CD+DA \\ p & =2AB+2BC \\ 40 & =2AB+2(12) \\ 40 & =2AB+24 \\ 2AB & =16 \\ AB & =8\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of the rectangle $ABCD$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =AB\cdot BC \\  & =8\cdot 12 \\  & =96.\end{aligned}
$$
